Intermediate.learningGoal: Build classes with metatables and __index, including method syntax and inheritance.
gotchas: Forgetting Class.__index = Class makes methods invisible
obj.method(obj) and obj:method() differ only in syntax, but calling with . loses self
Mutable fields defined on the class are shared by all instances
goodSolutionShows: Instance state set in new, not on the class table
shapeHints: an Entity base class with a Player subclass
an Account class with deposit and withdraw

gotchas: __eq is only consulted for two distinct tables, and 5.1 requires both to share the same __eq function (use one metatable for all instances)
Define __le explicitly; relying on the 5.1 fallback to not (b < a) breaks on newer Lua
__index with a function receives (table, key); rawget avoids recursion
goodSolutionShows: A Vec2 or Version type with __add, __eq, __lt and __tostring
Tests comparing with == and < on instances
shapeHints: a Money type with __tostring and arithmetic

Expert.learningGoal: Control table access with __index and __newindex proxies, read-only tables and defaults.
gotchas: pairs on a proxy walks the proxy's own (empty) keys; do not rely on __pairs, which not every runtime honours, and expose an explicit iterator method instead
# on an empty proxy is 0 and __len is not honoured for tables on 5.1, so expose an explicit size method
goodSolutionShows: Read-only proxy raising an error on write
shapeHints: a table with default values per key
a change tracker recording writes for undo
